# Use of Generative AI {.unnumbered}

I report the use of generative AI following the AIdIT framework [@drobniak2026aidit]. I used the following AI engine in the present study: Claude Opus (Anthropic), via Claude Code (v. claude-opus-5-5; timestamps: 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-18). Area(s) of generative AI usage: new code generation, code generation for visuals, data analysis, identification of literature to cite, text generation based on prompts, bibliography management, text editing for style/grammar/spelling. I declare that I have verified and approved all content generated or modified by the AI tools used. The use of AI in this paper was in compliance with the ethical regulations of all funders and host institutions. Representative prompts used in AI content generation are available upon request. The AI engine wrote the R code of the package, its tests, documentation and validation scripts under my direction, following the models I chose and the decisions I made on how departures from published models should be investigated; the commits made with the AI engine are identified as such in the history of the repository. The AI engine also drafted the manuscript from the documentation and saved results of the package, and searched for references, each of which was checked against Crossref metadata before inclusion.
